paper_id: Natural Language Inference by Tree-Based Convolution and Heuristic Matching__oa_W2469057590
title: Natural Language Inference by Tree-Based Convolution and Heuristic Matching
motivation: 现有神经网络模型在句对建模时未能充分利用句法结构信息
problem_framing: NLI任务中两句话的语义关系分类,采用Siamese架构
key_insight: 依赖树卷积比序列卷积更能捕获结构信息,且向量差操作能捕捉句子对应关系
method_signature: TBCNN编码句子+拼接/元素积/元素差匹配
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 单独使用element-wise product效果显著差于拼接或差操作
evidence_for_taste: TBCNN is more robust than sequential convolution
element-wise difference matching layer does not add to model complexity
explicitly using such heuristic yields an accuracy boost of 1–2%
may fail to fully make use of the syntactical information
may suffer from the problem of long propagation path
thinking_moves: 比较树结构卷积与序列卷积对词序扭曲的鲁棒性差异
将复杂匹配操作分解为简单的拼接/差/积组合以验证各自贡献
从word analogy任务中向量偏移的线性规律类比到句子层级
承认element-wise product单独使用效果差,承认某些方法可被其他方法吸收但显式建模仍有益
